item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong direct evidence that Marcos systematically used permits, jobs, housing, or benefits as explicit loyalty rewards or punishments in 2024. The best evidence is indirect: institutionalized benefit delivery and procurement reform point away from patronage, while red-tagging and intimidation point toward a coercive environment for critics. I also found little directly on civil-service hiring, permits, or housing allocation. That means this lens is better supported for benefits and social protection than for the full “welfare/permits/jobs/housing” range.","evidence":[{"title":"Pag-Abot institutionalization for vulnerable street dwellers","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office via PIA","date":"January 22, 2024","url":"https://mirror.pia.gov.ph/press-releases/2024/01/22/pbbm-issues-eo-no-52-institutionalizing-and-expanding-dswds-pag-abot-program-for-street-dwellers-other-poor-and-vulnerable-individuals","summary":"Marcos institutionalized a cross-agency package for street dwellers and other poor/vulnerable people, including shelter, livelihood, employment, and social-safety-net support. This is strong evidence of formalized access rather than loyalty-based handouts.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"4Ps expansion to pregnant and lactating women","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"June 11, 2024","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-orders-4ps-expansion-to-cover-pregnant-lactating-women-to-ensure-childrens-health-well-being-in-first-1000-days/","summary":"The administration expanded a core cash-transfer program to pregnant and lactating women, explicitly tying the benefit to maternal-child health and nutrition. This supports a dignity/equal-opportunity reading because it targets a high-need group, not a political base.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","6B.6"]},{"title":"PWD and senior-citizen benefits","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"July 23, 2024","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-fosters-pwd-friendly-philippines/","summary":"Marcos announced special interventions for persons with disabilities and PhilHealth benefits for PWD children and senior citizens. That is direct, identity-based protection of vulnerable groups rather than generic welfare numbers.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"MAKABATA child-protection system","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"December 10, 2024","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-okays-one-stop-system-for-reporting-child-rights-violations/","summary":"Marcos approved a one-stop reporting and support system for abused, neglected, exploited, trafficked, disabled, and HIV-affected children. This is strong evidence of institution-based protection for a highly vulnerable group.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","6B.6"]},{"title":"Women’s protection campaign and survivor services","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"December 2, 2024","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/govt-backs-campaign-to-end-violence-against-women/","summary":"The administration backed a national campaign against violence toward women, framing it as a rights issue across different backgrounds. This is relevant to dignity and equal treatment, though it is still mostly programmatic and rhetorical.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"DSWD support for women and child survivors","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"December 11, 2024","url":"https://mirror.pco.gov.ph/news_releases/dswd-touts-govt-efforts-to-end-violence-abuse-against-women-children/","summary":"DSWD described stronger referral, legal, medical, and shelter support for women and child survivors of abuse. This is concrete service delivery to vulnerable people, not merely aggregate redistribution.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"Bangsamoro / Marawi inclusion","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"July 24, 2024","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbms-sona-highlights-significant-progress-in-barmm-bangsamoro-leaders-react/","summary":"Marcos highlighted Marawi rehabilitation and peace-agreement implementation, signaling attention to a historically marginalized conflict zone. This supports a limited equal-opportunity reading for a region long excluded from national development.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"Peaceful, transparent BARMM elections","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"June 24, 2024","url":"https://mirror.pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-sees-peaceful-orderly-barmm-poll/","summary":"Marcos publicly urged a peaceful and transparent first BARMM parliamentary election. This is weaker than hard policy, but it points toward respecting political participation in a marginalized region.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"Procurement reform against favoritism","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"July 20, 2024","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-signs-laws-on-streamlining-procurement-combatting-online-scams/","summary":"The New Government Procurement Act standardized forms and institutionalized e-procurement, reducing leakage and discretionary favoritism. This matters for equal opportunity because it cuts channels for rent allocation and insider advantage.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","6B.5"]},{"title":"DOF/IMF-style evidence of technocratic administration","publisher":"Department of Finance","date":"April 29, 2024","url":"https://www.dof.gov.ph/recto-hits-the-ground-running-towards-an-inclusive-future-that-benefits-all-filipinos-introduces-growth-enhancing-roadmap-in-his-first-100-days-in-office/","summary":"Recto said Marcos gave the economic team room to recalibrate fiscal targets and push a growth roadmap. That is indirect evidence against a pure patronage model and for policy managed through institutions.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","6B.5"]},{"title":"Red-tagging and intimidation persisted","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"January 11, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/philippines-red-tagging-puts-activists-risk","summary":"HRW said government supporters and officials continued red-tagging critics under Marcos, putting leftist activists at serious risk. This is strong negative evidence against equal protection for unpopular voices.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","6B.6"]},{"title":"Union leaders and multiple vulnerable groups were threatened","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"September 25, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/25/philippines-dangerous-red-tagging-labor-leaders","summary":"HRW reported officials and security actors threatened union leaders and also targeted women’s groups, Indigenous peoples, journalists, teachers, and judges. This is direct counterevidence to a clean dignity/equal-opportunity finding.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","6B.6"]},{"title":"Amnesty on fear climate and anti-terror framing","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"October 14, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/asa35/8574/2024/en/","summary":"Amnesty said Marcos-era actors weaponized misinformation and anti-terror framing to create fear, including red-tagging against activists, journalists, teachers, and others. This supports the view that vulnerability and civic equality remained compromised.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","6B.6"]},{"title":"Freedom House on weak minority protections","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/philippines/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House said Indigenous people faced harassment and violence in Mindanao, LGBT+ protections were weak, disability protections were weakly enforced, and women’s representation remained concentrated in political families. This is broad background evidence against equal opportunity.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","6B.6"]},{"title":"State Department on continued abuses despite reform","publisher":"U.S. Department of State via ecoi.net","date":"2024","url":"https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128580.html","summary":"The report says credible killings, disappearances, torture, arbitrary detention, media restrictions, and threats to labor activists remained. Even with some due-process shift, the state was not consistently protecting dignity.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","6B.6"]}]}
